methodology: Numbers computed at build time. The same script that builds the network writes provenance.json, with counts, km, corrections and file hashes. Nothing is typed by hand, so the printed percentages cannot drift from the data.
caveats: This is a 2022/23 snapshot. Valid as of June 2024 publication date; does not reflect live conditions.
The 99.2% figure is a share of road-link length, not of the app.
Table 5 and Table 6 appear identical in the extracted data; both reference district HQ distances from Kathmandu via NH17.
DoR publishes only ~66 hub pairs (Table 4), 77 HQ distances (Table 5/6), and NH01 place-to-place distances. Everything else is a link-sum or estimate.
